card.name: Dashes between book chapter headings
card.fires_on: Em dashes or hyphens that separate topic phrases in old book tables of contents or chapter summaries. Also weakly on a few heading words in such history texts.

modes.label: Dash in contents list
modes.description: An em dash splitting one topic from the next in a chapter heading list.
modes.example: The Irish were probably Fire-worshippers<<—>>The Customs of Ancient Erinn—Similar

modes.label: Heading hyphen
modes.description: A hyphen or dash after a title phrase in an all-caps heading.
modes.example: ANCIENT MEXICO- ITS CLIMATE AND ITS PRODUCTS<<->> ITS PRIMITIVE RACES- AZTE

card.plain: It marks the dashes that separate topics in the headings of old history books.
